title: RT60013: Physical Testing Of Rubbers
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Tests on raw and compounded rubbers: plasticity, plasticity retention index,
Plastimeters, Rotational viscometer, Mooney viscometer, Oscillating Disc
rheometer, ODR and MDR 2000 etc. Extrusion plastimeter, Brabender Plastograph,
Tack. Tackmeters, Shrinkage, Green strength, Processibility Testers. Tests on
Vulcanized rubbers : Short-term stress-strain : tensile, compression
